_readme.fusi.t: frame times (s) of the 249 frames used
_readme.fusi.y: ROI signal, % change, drift and motion removed (500 voxels picked by a timing-agnostic F-test)
_readme.fusi.shifts / fusi.r2 / fusi.fits: onset shift (s), variance explained beyond nuisance, and fitted Glover model per shift (aligned with fusi.t)
_readme.fusi.blocks: task blocks (type, onset s, duration s)
_readme.fusi.timing: results/fusi/timing_summary.json (gamma fits, shift scan, cross-validated shifts)
_readme.tribe.lags / tribe.tc: block-locked TRIBE predictions (audio-only mode), seconds from block onset; tc[condition][roi].speech|control
_readme.tribe.retention / paired / paired_varian: audio-only retention with 95% CIs; paired contrasts for synthesis A and B
_readme.tribe.timing: gamma fit to TRIBE's predicted HG response
_readme.tribe.spec: spectrograms of one control block per condition: uint8 base64, h=96 rows (top = 8 kHz), w columns over 3 s, values = dB mapped -110..-40 to 0..255
_readme.modes.change: results/insilico/mode_change.tsv: retention audio-only vs audio+text, paired change and 95% CI
_readme.modes.words: fraction of each control passage's words recovered by WhisperX
_readme.zmap_png: base64 PNG of the speech > audio-only z map
